data.name: INVALID_REQUEST
data.value: Check the command, plugin ID, and request arguments.

data.name: SESSION_MISMATCH
data.value: This request belongs to another SDK session. Read the current session status.

data.name: PLUGIN_NOT_LOADED
data.value: Load the plugin before invoking its commands.

data.name: RELOAD_FAILED
data.value: The new plugin generation could not be activated. Inspect the SDK diagnostic log; previous behavior is retained when possible.

data.name: PLUGIN_ID_MISMATCH
data.value: The plugin manifest ID does not match its installation directory.

data.name: SDK_BUSY
data.value: An SDK operation is still running. Read its result before submitting another mutation.

data.name: INTERNAL_FAILURE
data.value: The SDK operation failed. Inspect the local diagnostic log before retrying.
